# Introduction {#sec-intro}

This book shows what **Folio** can render live. See @knuth84 for literate
programming, and @sec-methods for the methods. As shown in @fig-growth, things grow.

::: {.callout-note}
## A note on notation
Inline math like $e^{i\pi} + 1 = 0$ renders instantly, and so does display math:

$$
\int_0^\infty e^{-x^2}\,dx = \frac{\sqrt{\pi}}{2}
$$ {#eq-gauss}
:::

Equation @eq-gauss is the Gaussian integral.

![A growth curve](images/growth.svg){#fig-growth width=60%}
